content.title: NBA Play-In Tournament bracket: 76ers secure No. 7 seed; Warriors win
content.text: April 14, 2026Updated April 16, 2026, 1:15 a.m. ETThe NBA postseason officially tipped off Tuesday, April 14 with two the 2026 NBA Play-In Tournament games. Two more Play-In games will take place Wednesday, April 15.In the opener, the Philadelphia 76ers secured the No. 7 playoff seed in the Eastern Conference with a 109-97 win over the Orlando Magic, who now must play the Charlotte Hornets on Friday, April 17 to decide which team earns the No. 8 seed in the East.Later, the Golden State Warriors defeated the Los Angeles Clippers in a dramatic, win-or-go-home showdown. The Warriors will face the Phoenix Suns on Friday, April 17 to determine the No. 8 playoff seed in the Western Conference.Here is the updated bracket and schedule for the 2026 NBA Play-In Tournament, along with the matchups for the first round of the NBA playoffs: Stream 2026 NBA Play-In Tournament on Prime VideoNBA Play-In Tournament results, scheduleThe losers of the No. 9 vs. No. 10 matchups will be eliminated from the postseason. The winners of the No. 7 vs. No. 8 games will solidify the No. 7 seeds in the NBA playoffs. The losers of those games will play the winners of the No. 9 vs. No. 10 matchups to claim the No. 8 seeds in the playoffs. All play-in games will be streamed exclusively on Amazon Prime Video.All times EasternTuesday, April 14East: No. 9 Charlotte Hornets 127, No. 10 Miami Heat 126 (OT)West: No. 8 Portland Trail Blazers 114, No. 7 Phoenix Suns 110Wednesday, April 15East: No. 7 Philadelphia 76ers 109, No. 8 Orlando Magic 97West: No. 10 Golden State Warriors 126, No. 9 L.A.
